beats: A kid opened the Play Store, reinstalled the TV app, and wiped every parental setting in one tap.
The guard already blocked YouTube and Spotify — but nothing stopped the Store or Settings themselves.
It's like locking the fridge but leaving the kitchen door wide open.
Now a home-PC script written in Python locks the Store, Settings and every install screen the same way.
One gap left in a system with an override for everything — now zero.
